company.name: Jalebi
company.shortDescription: Jalebi is a restaurant operating system that helps food businesses manage POS, inventory, orders & analytics from a single cloud platform.
company.description: jalebi.io is a UAE-based foodtech company that provides an AI-enabled restaurant operating system designed for cafes, restaurants, and multi-branch food businesses. The platform combines inventory management, point-of-sale (POS), supplier CRM, menu management, analytics, reporting, and operational workflows into one integrated solution. Built by restaurant operators and technologists, jalebi.io focuses on reducing food waste, improving cost efficiency, streamlining kitchen operations, and increasing profitability for F&B businesses. The company is backed by Techstars and serves food operators across the GCC and other international markets
